scope: Initial compositor-only comparison, BEFORE the final raw-frame pacing correction. Short/noisy sample; after may overlap another browser startup. Indicative only, not a CI cure, physical-device or cloud-load benchmark.

before.label: before
before.method: Three isolated visible local practice contexts, forced ANGLE SwiftShader, same1440/360/390 viewports, night+drizzle fixture. Six-second north key hold, actualelapsed measured. Rolling metrics include bootstrap; frame-count deltas report sample average, not physical-device performance.
